public_disclosure_controls: No client/customer names or uniquely identifying customer details.
No coworker, executive, auditor, recommender, partner-contact, or third-party individual names without explicit approval.
No personal contact information, tenant IDs, account IDs, hostnames, IP addresses, credentials, secrets, or internal URLs.
No raw source documents, emails, audit evidence, spreadsheets, screenshots, or internal transition trackers.
No exact SKU counts, confidential vendor pricing, contract renewal dates, internal commercial terms, or detailed budget tables.
No incident-forensics detail, active security weaknesses, remediation gaps, or environment-specific reconnaissance detail.
Use rounded resume-level company, system, portfolio, and financial metrics in this public repository.
claim_controls: Do not represent modeled/recommended cloud savings as realized without separate implementation evidence.
Do not represent unredeemed partner entitlements as captured savings.
Preserve OWNED, LED, SPONSORED, CONTRIBUTED, INHERITED, and APPROVED distinctions.
Do not claim projects assigned to other engineers as Harvey's projects.
Do not publish a numerical promotion count until the role-sequence discrepancy is reconciled.
Use LinkedIn dates/titles where screenshots provide exact evidence and note discrepancies rather than silently normalizing them.
Generate public-facing material from this sanitized dataset rather than from raw private source documents.
data_gaps: endpoint/device counts if suitable for public disclosure
managed-services client counts if suitable for public disclosure
uptime/SLA metrics if suitable for public disclosure
